questions.stem: What is the relative formula mass (Mr) of sulfuric acid, H₂SO₄? (Ar: H = 1, S = 32, O = 16)
questions.explanation: Mr of H₂SO₄ = (2 × 1) + (1 × 32) + (4 × 16) = 2 + 32 + 64 = 98. Remember to multiply each Ar by the number of atoms of that element in the formula.

questions.stem: What is the relative formula mass (Mr) of calcium hydroxide, Ca(OH)₂? (Ar: Ca = 40, O = 16, H = 1)
questions.explanation: Ca(OH)₂ contains 1 Ca, 2 O, and 2 H (the subscript 2 outside the bracket multiplies everything inside). Mr = (1 × 40) + (2 × 16) + (2 × 1) = 40 + 32 + 2 = 74.
